title: Peak surge schematic and skill-cushion staffing protocol
creator: Priya Kapoor
description: Create an operational playbook and templates to hedge mid-cycle capacity risk during peak surges. The playbook will define: (1) how to compute a skill-cushion (target FTE multiplier per critical skill), (2) a small-surface shadowing rotation to seed contingency capacity, (3) surge lanes and microtranche policy for rapid scope evictions, and (4) runbook for cost vs. coverage trade-offs. Goal: reduce mid-cycle unplanned decommits by 40% and ensure >90% of critical-path tickets have a designated backup or shadow before the cycle midpoint.
updates: 2025-01-27: Kickoff with ENG, Design, and People Ops. Agreed success metrics and top 6 critical skills for Q1 (runtime infra, autoscaler, CI, console, release-engineering, SRE).

2025-01-30: Draft formula for skill-cushion: recommended multiplier = max(1.15, 1 + (risk_score * 0.25)). Risk score computed from historical churn and expertise density (prototype spreadsheet uploaded).

2025-02-03: PM/Eng sync - engineering prefers skill-focused shadowing over full-time float due to cost. Decided pilot uses 1.2x cushion for infra-heavy pods and 1.1x for product teams. Marcus to update pilot roster.
2025-02-05: Design review - UX for the staffing dashboard proposed (compact view showing cushion coverage, shadow assignments, and surge-lane buckets). Assigned DES-4312 for dashboard mockups.

2025-02-07: Trial run planning: pilot on two pods (Serving Runtime and Console Ops) for Cycle 2025-W08; scope eviction rules and communication templates drafted. PRD: https://confluence.redwood.ai/cycle-flex/pm-273920-prd
2025-02-09: Leadership review: approved pilot and budget for 0.5 FTE reserve pool. Action: create GitHub tracking board and a retro checklist template.

2025-02-10: Launched hiring/rotation readme and pilot roster; engineering requested an automated signal (based on ticket backlog velocity) to open surge lanes. Added ENG-19821 as a follow-up automation task.
acceptance_criteria: Playbook document published in Confluence with step-by-step runbooks and template checklists
Dashboard prototype mockups reviewed and prioritized in next design cycle
Pilot executed for two pods in Cycle 2025-W08 and coverage metrics captured
Metrics: mid-cycle unplanned decommit rate measured and baseline established
Decision matrix for cost vs. cushion level validated with finance and eng leads
risks: Over-provisioning increases cost; finance pushback if cushion multiplier above agreed thresholds
Shadowing may dilute velocity if not time-boxed; need explicit shadow responsibilities and length
Automation signals could create noise; threshold tuning required before wide rollout
Cross-team coordination overhead during surge could slow urgent work without clear owner assignments
